description: Checklist-first map generation pipeline for Heavy Armor CSV maps. This file is the source of truth when generating maps. Older mapgen rule files may be used as reference only when this pipeline explicitly points to them. If older rules conflict with this pipeline, follow this pipeline.
hardInvariants: Generate floors first. Do not generate walls room-by-room.
Walls are derived once from the final union of all floor regions.
No double walls anywhere. Do not solve exposed floors by adding a second wall layer.
Every visible exterior border of the final ragged shape must be wall, door, or window.
No floor tile may touch outside or missing space in the four cardinal directions.
Interior doors must connect floor to floor on opposite through-sides.
Exterior doors may connect floor to outside, but exterior doors do not count for room-to-room connectivity.
Doors may not be adjacent to other doors.
All rooms must be reachable from all other rooms through interior floors and valid interior doors.

pipeline.name: Read request settings
instructions: Record requested map name, maximum width, maximum height, raggedness, required room sizes/counts, and required special contents.
Treat requested width and height as the target canvas for raggedness 0 and as a maximum canvas for higher raggedness values.

pipeline.name: Choose room interiors
instructions: Room size categories are based only on interior floor tile area.
Small rooms are 1-9 floor tiles.
Medium rooms are 9-18 floor tiles.
Large rooms are 18-30 floor tiles.
Rooms may be rectangles or squares.
Prefer the largest valid room interiors in the requested size band before creating smaller rooms.
If a clean fit is impossible, shrink edge or corner rooms within their size band before adding padding.

pipeline.name: Place floor regions only
instructions: Place only floor interiors for all rooms.
Do not place walls, doors, or windows yet.
Allow rooms to touch conceptually, but do not create overlapping floor interiors unless intentionally merging rooms.

pipeline.name: Derive one wall layer from floor union
instructions: Create walls around the final union of floor regions, not around each room independently.
Any non-floor tile directly north, south, east, or west of a floor tile becomes wall unless it will later become a valid door or window.
Because walls are derived from the floor union once, shared/internal walls must be one tile thick only.
Do not add all-wall padding rows or columns outside this wall layer.

pipeline.name: Identify rooms and internal wall seams
instructions: Track which floor tiles belong to each intended room.
A wall tile between two rooms is an internal wall candidate.
A wall tile touching outside/missing space is an exterior wall candidate.

pipeline.name: Place doors
instructions: Place doors only by replacing existing wall tiles.
Interior doors must have floor on two opposite through-sides: north/south or east/west.
Exterior doors must have floor on one through-side and outside/missing space on the other through-side.
A door may not open into a wall, window, or another door.
Doors may not be adjacent to other doors in any cardinal direction.
Not every room needs a door on every wall.
Remove unnecessary doors if the room remains internally reachable.

pipeline.name: Validate room connectivity
instructions: Using only floor tiles and valid interior doors, verify every room can reach every other room.
Exterior doors do not count for room-to-room connectivity.
If a room is isolated, add or move one valid interior door on a wall seam; do not add door chains or adjacent doors.

pipeline.name: Apply raggedness trim
instructions: Raggedness 0 preserves the requested rectangle as closely as possible.
Raggedness 1-3 allows small local trims on edges or corners but should broadly preserve the requested footprint.
Raggedness 4-6 allows noticeable uneven edges while still resembling the requested size.
Raggedness 7-9 allows major cuts while preserving useful generated structure.
Raggedness 10 trims to the generated contents and required enclosing walls only.
Trim only outside the single derived wall layer.
Never trim a wall if doing so would expose a floor tile to outside/missing space.
Never fill ragged trim gaps with a second wall layer.

pipeline.name: Validate final border
instructions: Check every existing tile in the final ragged CSV shape.
If any floor tile has outside/missing space directly north, south, east, or west, the map is invalid.
Every exposed outside-facing tile must be wall, window, or a valid exterior door.
Ragged row overhangs are allowed only when the overhanging tiles are exterior-safe border tiles, not floors.

pipeline.name: Validate no double walls
instructions: Reject any parallel adjacent wall layers where a wall/door/window line is backed by another wall/door/window line instead of floor or outside.
Reject wall-door-wall caps backed by wall-wall-wall or similar patterns.
If a double wall is found, fix it by trimming the shape, resizing a room, or moving the border. Do not add more walls.

pipeline.name: Export CSV
instructions: Export only after all validations pass.
Use one CSV cell per map tile.
Use the app-compatible format: <asset type>, <damage>, <variant>.
